news.title: ACE Survey: Financial Viability and Perceptions of Value are Top of Mind for Higher Ed Leaders
news.summary_en: Public perceptions about value and long-term financial viability are the most pressing issues for higher education leaders who responded to the latest ACE Pulse Point survey.

news.title: International Students Face New Immigration Hurdles This Year
news.summary_en: International students are heading into another difficult fall, with new immigration restrictions taking effect just as applications and enrollment are already falling.
